seven-section owner direction. It preserves A/B/C and all previous nonclaims.

model spaces and their transformations; the amended seven-role response catalog
with its exact supersession/component relations; unambiguous absolute-index
wording; and all nine terminal-selection record fields. The owner request is
included only as manager provenance; the fresh author reads the permitted

Use all response-role identities and typed statuses required by the applicable
method and claim. A required status may be unavailable; no universal numerical
response availability follows. RF-03 covers one iteration with prior S_k fixed.
RF-04 covers fixed sequence/index recursion; RF-05 includes convergence,
stopping, resource limits and terminal selection. RF-07 composes the complete
FRUIT-only response to perturbed realized parent-domain payload, holding the
upstream producer operation, learned state and generation fixed. It references
RF-03/RF-04/RF-05 components, not duplicate aliases. RF-06 reruns included
data-dependent upstream producers. The ledger supplies the exact crosswalk.

FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD = unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval.
No numerical parent, model, projector, residual/rejoin operator, recurrence,

## Digest closure, compatibility and Stage B disposition

`AUTHOR_INPUT_MANIFEST.sha256` binds these exact manifest bytes; the manifest
does not hash itself. `SCI-FRUIT-v0.1-stage-a-r0.4-amended-owner-review.tar.gz`
contains exactly the thirteen payloads, this manifest and its sidecar: fifteen
regular members with matching bytes and no additional paths. The external
`SCI-FRUIT-v0.1-stage-a-r0.4-amended-owner-review.tar.gz.sha256` binds the
archive. Archive and archive sidecar are delivery controls and are not
recursively embedded. Every payload row binds exact role, byte count, SHA-256,
authority, compatibility/supersession and author permission.

Approval of these exact amended bytes replaces the unamended r0.4 author read
set for this task, not the inherited authorities or numerical gates. After
Grant Wilson approves the exact amended packet, launch Stage B in a fresh
implementation-blind thread, as directed in section 7 of the current owner
amendment. Architecture acceptance is not exact packet approval; the condition
remains unmet and no author is launched now.

Stage B may author and later seek conditional freeze while every numerical
parent, model, recurrence, stopping, response, covariance and downstream-use
route remains unavailable. It must not infer familiar FRUIT practice, existing
implementation behavior or a numerical default. Universal core completion
requirements cannot be waived by a method. Model rejoin in an upstream
unavailable mode remains model_or_prior_supported, without observational
recovery, acquired exposure or unit-response truth. Packet approval and launch
do not approve the later scientific substance or freeze the core.

No implementation, schema, configuration/default, test, audit/repair, reduction,
generated numerical product, performance/validation/production record, Unity,
web source, unrestricted repository or prior conversation is an author input.
Only later explicit owner answers may amend the approved read set; a precise
unresolved scientific premise returns to the owner without importing unlisted
sources. This statement authorizes no further broad Stage A derivation.
